posts.title: Lalalala
posts.content_md:
Lalalalala my own website, complete with a database, a frontend, API, I honestly thought it would be a quick little hobby project. You know like write some code, ask AI for help, watch magic happen. Turns out… nope. Without actual knowledge and a decent amount of time, building a full website from scratch in Visual Studio Code is like trying to assemble IKEA furniture without the manual: technically possible, but you’ll question your life choices.
But hey, challenge accepted. I’ve already reached the point of no return. I’m not giving up until this thing runs exactly the way I pictured it.
